description: The agent must: (1) Read scripts/init-artifact.sh and run it as `bash scripts/init-artifact.sh harbor-ops` to scaffold the React+TypeScript+Tailwind+shadcn/ui project — NOT use npm create vite or any other generic scaffolding. (2) Navigate into the harbor-ops/ directory and develop the dashboard in src/App.tsx (or equivalent), using shadcn/ui components (Card, Tabs, Badge) from @/components/ui/ with the @/ path alias, incorporating all three required sections with the hardcoded data from the requirements file. (3) Critically, the agent must NOT use Inter font or purple/violet gradients per the design guidelines in SKILL.md. (4) Run `bash scripts/bundle-artifact.sh` from inside the harbor-ops directory — NOT vite build or webpack — to produce bundle.html via Parcel + html-inline. (5) The resulting bundle.html must be self-contained (all JS/CSS inlined), contain React runtime fingerprints proving it was built via the proprietary pipeline, and contain all required UI content.
